description: This source file contains the implementation of the PollingStateImpl class, which manages and tracks polling states for ECU communication in the RomRaider project. It includes methods for getting and setting poll states and query flags, as well as a toString method for state representation.

classes.name: PollingStateImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the PollingState interface, managing polling states and flags for ECU communication.
